item.p: In ⲛⲡⲧⲏⲛⲉ and ⲛⲧⲙⲉⲣⲓⲥ, a dot above ⲛ.
In ϩⲛⲕⲁⲓⲥϩⲁⲓ, a dot above ⲛ.
In ⲙⲛ, a dot above ⲛ.
In ⲧⲛⲕⲱ and ⲛⲣⲁⲥⲧⲉ, a dot above ⲛ. In ⲃⲓⲧⲟⲩ, a dot above ⲩ.
In ⲛⲧⲕⲩⲣⲓⲁⲕⲏ, a dot above ⲛ.
In ⲛⲕⲁⲓⲗⲁⲁⲩ, a dot above ⲩ.
In ⲡⲗⲏⲣⲟⲩ, a dot above ⲩ.

It is not sure whether this line, written in bigger characters, contains the address of the official letter, or belongs to the second text. If the latter is the case, the reading ⲡ̣ⲁⲥ̣ⲟ̣ⲛ̣ seems plausible.
